outcome: success rate of karyotyping using chorionic villi
cohort: The study included adult women with first-trimester miscarriage who underwent USG-MVA in Hong Kong between July 2015 and February 2021.
finding: Ultrasound-guided manual vacuum aspiration was found to be a safe and effective method for managing first-trimester miscarriage, with a 94.6% complete evacuation rate, high procedural tolerance, 95.2% karyotyping success, and no major complications.
